nodes.label: PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)

nodes.label: JWT Validation Mode (local signature check)
nodes.rationale: Validates JWT signature locally using shared secret - no network call needed, fast. Trade-off: cannot detect revoked tokens.

nodes.label: Token Introspection Mode
nodes.rationale: Resource Server calls /introspect on Auth Server - slower but handles revoked tokens and complex scenarios.

nodes.label: PEP 8 Code Style
nodes.rationale: Python code style standard: 100 char line length, type hints required, Google-style docstrings

nodes.label: Secure Cookie Storage (HttpOnly, Secure flags)
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly and Secure flags enabled for refresh token cookies to prevent XSS and MITM attacks
